user_prompt:
Add the meta muse coding harness to the website to the correct section, and grok build and grok bot. Research all info before adding to the correctly research section.

Push all

entities.one_line: Meta terminal coding harness (beta) powered by Muse Spark 1.2; persistent background agents and a local event log.

search_entries.title: Muse Code
search_entries.desc: Meta terminal coding harness (beta) powered by Muse Spark 1.2; persistent background agents and a local event log.

research.notes: Official name is Muse Code (the coding harness), not a separate Meta Muse product. Powered by Muse Spark 1.2, co-trained with the harness. Install: curl -fsSL https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh | bash (macOS/Linux). Features: async persistent background agents, append-only local event log (replay-exact, restart-safe), bundled skills /plan /grill /goal, subagent fan-out, MCP, headless CI. Product page developer.meta.com/ai/products/muse-code/. Place in tools.html CLI A-Z (after Mistral Vibe, before NemoClaw) plus companies.html Meta. Do not put on chats.html (not a lab chat). Muse Spark 1.2 is the model, not the harness card.

entities.one_line: xAI terminal coding agent powered by Grok 4.6; TUI, skills, subagents, MCP, and headless CI.

search_entries.title: Grok Build
search_entries.desc: xAI terminal coding agent powered by Grok 4.6; TUI, skills, subagents, MCP, and headless CI.

research.notes: SpaceXAI/xAI coding agent harness and TUI. Product: x.ai/build (also x.ai/cli). Install: curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash; Windows irm https://x.ai/cli/install.ps1 | iex. Command: grok. Powered by Grok 4.6. Interactive TUI, headless scripting, Agent Client Protocol (ACP). Skills, plugins, marketplaces, hooks, MCP, AGENTS.md, plan mode, subagents, worktrees. GitHub xai-org/grok-build Apache 2.0 (Rust). Docs docs.x.ai/build/overview. Place CLI A-Z after Goose, before Junie CLI; companies.html xAI after Grok. Distinct from Grok chat (chats.html) and Grok Bot.

entities.one_line: xAI AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer; message from desktop or iOS until they need approval.

search_entries.title: Grok Bot
search_entries.desc: xAI AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer; message from desktop or iOS until they need approval.

research.notes: Not a coding CLI and not Grok chat. Durable named AI teammates with a user-scoped persistent cloud Linux VM (browser, filesystem, terminal, computer use, MCP). Multiple Bots share one computer — not a security boundary. Desktop macOS/Windows + iOS. Early beta; included with SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Ultra, Cursor Teams Premium. Product https://x.ai/bot launched 2026-08-11. Place tools.html#computer-automation with other hosted cloud agents (before MaxClaw), plus companies.html xAI. Do not put on chats.html or other-assistants.html.
